verdict.rationale: Docs confirm only two form factors — USB-A/NFC and USB-C/NFC (google-titan-docs-13) — covering the port-compatibility part of the story, but there is no evidence of a keychain or low-profile 'nano' variant; community feedback even complains the key is bulky rather than subtle (google-titan-comm-6). missing for 10: keychain/nano low-profile SKU documentation, evidence of multiple carry-style form factors beyond the two USB variants.
